editor.network.networks.help: Per netwerk: name, type (wlan of lan) en connected_users.
editor.network.devices.help: Per apparaat: name, type, device_tracker, cpu, memory en restart_action.
editor.network.example:
networks:
  - name: WiFi
    type: wlan                          # wlan of lan
    connected_users: sensor.wifi_users  # of een lijst met sensoren (wordt opgeteld)
devices:
  - name: Router
    type: router                        # router, switch of ap
    device_tracker: device_tracker.router
    ip: 192.168.1.1                     # alleen zonder device_tracker
    cpu: sensor.router_cpu
    memory: sensor.router_memory
    restart_action:
      action: perform-action
      perform_action: button.press
      target:
        entity_id: button.router_restart
editor.synology.name: Naam van de NAS
editor.synology.volumes.help: Per volume: name, used, size, status en disks (name, type, temperature, status).
editor.synology.example:
volumes:
  - name: Volume 1
    used: sensor.volume_1_used
    size: sensor.volume_1_size
    status: sensor.volume_1_status
    disks:
      - name: Schijf 1
        type: hdd                       # hdd of ssd
        temperature: sensor.disk_1_temperature
        status: sensor.disk_1_status
editor.docker.projects.help: Per project: name en containers. Overige containers komen onder Overig.
editor.docker.example:
projects:
  - name: Media
    containers:
      - plex
      - sonarr
  - name: Tools
    containers:
      - ghost
